source: A study of 240 support agents found that agents using the assistant resolved tickets 14% faster on average. The authors note the effect was concentrated among agents with less than six months of tenure and did not reach significance for experienced agents.
summary: In a study of 240 support agents, those using the assistant resolved tickets 14% faster on average. The effect was concentrated among newer agents and was not significant for experienced ones.
